body:
The server can create and change a design, and each change saves a version, so no earlier state is lost. Agents and the page use this later; this task adds only the server's internal path, with no route an agent can call.

### Do

- Add one server function that validates a design and writes it. A design that fails validation is not saved and the file stays as it was.
- Each save appends a version: the whole design, its time, and who it came from (a human or a design run).
- Versions live in Solace's own data, as a cursory suggestion under `.solace/design/`, written only by the task server. The current design stays in the repo.
- Writes are atomic, so a crash leaves the previous design whole.
- Saving identical content adds no version.

### Acceptance

- Tests: creating a design saves version 1; a change saves version 2 and keeps version 1; an invalid design changes nothing on disk; an identical save adds nothing.

### Left out

Restoring, reading versions, and any page. History doesn't travel with a clone for now, because `.solace/` isn't committed; feature:9d778f6e03dea799 leaves that open.
title: design: save with a version
